stem.text: A mass of $0.20\,\text{kg}$ is suspended from the lower end of a light spring. A second mass of $0.10\,\text{kg}$ is suspended from the first mass by a thread. The arrangement is allowed to come into static equilibrium and then the thread is cut.

stem.alt: Spring hanging from a fixed support, with a thread joining a 0.20 kg mass below it to a second 0.10 kg mass; labels spring, thread, 0.20 kg and 0.10 kg.

stem.text: Immediately after the thread is cut, what is the upward acceleration of the $0.20\,\text{kg}$ mass?
